basis: Defining skeletal growth delay and microcephaly; hypermetropia 2/2; delayed thelarche 1/1 with reported delayed puberty. Nail hypoplasia 1/2 omitted at cap.

decisions.dermatologic: none: nail hypoplasia in 1/2 qualifies by frequency but is omitted at the four-axis cap in favor of visual and pubertal dysfunction.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: delayed thelarche in 1/1 assessed female and reported delayed puberty support endocrine dysfunction; genital anatomy alone would not.

basis: Severe intellectual disability, limb defects and cleft palate/GI malformations characterize the syndrome. Unspecified genitourinary anomalies do not establish renal disease.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: cleft palate and gastrointestinal malformations are explicit components of the defining phenotype; the oral cavity belongs to this axis.

basis: Photosensitive progeroid skin; sicca and delayed permanent dentition each 2/3; dental crowding, anemia and thrombocytopenia each 1/3. Muscle atrophy 1/3 omitted at cap.

decisions.haematologic: involved: anemia and thrombocytopenia each occur in 1/3 patients, meeting the supplied frequency threshold for blood-cell dysfunction.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: muscle atrophy in 1/3 qualifies, but is omitted at the four-axis cap; long thumbs alone do not demonstrate locomotor impairment.

basis: Inherited sensorimotor neuropathy with structural pes cavus in 3/6 patients (50%); hearing impairment in 1/6 is below threshold.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: pes cavus in 3/6 represents persistent structural foot deformity intrinsic to the neuropathy, rather than weakness alone.

basis: Defining congenital hypoparathyroidism and skeletal dysplasia; microcephaly occurs in 30-79%. Hypocalcemic seizures alone do not establish brain damage; caries is separate.

decisions.neurologic: involved: microcephaly is a structural neurodevelopmental abnormality reported in 30-79%; the label does not rely on transient hypocalcemic seizures.

basis: Arthrogryposis, myopathy and cutaneous pterygia define it. Cleft palate and conductive hearing loss each occur in 30-79%; ptosis (30-79%) omitted at cap.

decisions.ocular: none: ptosis occurs in 30-79%, but is omitted at the four-axis cap in favor of defining skin webs, cleft palate and hearing impairment.
decisions.dermatologic: primary: multiple cutaneous pterygia are named defining malformations; webbed neck is reported in 80-99%.

basis: Histiocytic skin nodules and destructive arthritis define the disease, each occurring in 80-99%; blood-cell or marrow dysfunction is not established.

decisions.haematologic: none: tissue histiocytic proliferation in skin and joints does not itself establish disease of circulating blood cells, marrow or coagulation.

basis: Monoclonal gammopathy causes proximal tubular light-chain injury; defining bicarbonate, phosphate and other solute wasting establishes renal and metabolic dysfunction.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: generalized Fanconi solute wasting includes defining bicarbonate and phosphate handling defects, placing this syndrome on the electrolyte/acid-base axis.

basis: Hereditary autonomic neuropathy; persistent contractures and progressive scoliosis affect approximately 30% or more across the spectrum. Abnormal sweating alone is not skin damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: congenital contractures and progressive scoliosis are common persistent structural manifestations, estimated at >=30% across the spectrum.

basis: Primary immunodeficiency with chronic airway destruction: bronchiectasis 12/16 (75%). Gut nodules occur in 30-79%, but malabsorption/diarrhea only 5-29%; enlargement alone is insufficient.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: frequent intestinal lymphoid nodules do not establish damaging or function-impairing infiltration; diarrhea and malabsorption occur in only 5-29%.
